Look around you! Stones discolored, blackened with age, moldy, mildewed, pointed arches, vulgarly ornate! Horrible! If this man wakens here there'll be more trouble, for he'll die on the spot. Forest springs, swans, naked beauties— that was his prophetic dream. How could he endure it here? Not even I with my adaptable nature could do that. Let’s get him out of here fast.
translation:
@@U03046@@
看看你的周围！石头变色了，随着时间的推移而变黑，发霉，发霉，尖拱，华丽粗俗！可怕！如果这个人在这里醒来，麻烦就更大了，他会当场死亡。森林泉水、天鹅、裸体美女——那是他的预言梦。他怎么能忍受这里？即使是我这种适应力强的人也做不到。我们快点带他离开这里吧。
